T-001.Title: Retire inode and descriptor proof while preserving functional and C6 controls

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Remove the exact three recycling-gated controls, thirteen pin lifecycle cases, direct identity assertions, and one incidental inode assertion enumerated in the spec. Remove the pre-pin archive and manifest, duplicate loaders, fixture tests, verifier, and its support tests. Remove helpers and imports exclusively used by those cases. Preserve the deterministic B/A/B token-and-byte control, byte-preservation and EEXIST/ENOTEMPTY tests, supersede transaction tests, C6 historical direction constants, C6 content and explicit-boundary tests, and unrelated active-directory checks. Do not edit runtime source or archived bundles.

T-002.Title: Remove retired workflow steps and add a discriminating absence guard

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Remove the six extra exact-head Validate steps and two Windows pin selector steps. Keep ordinary Validate checkout, install, validation, and release steps plus unrelated Windows and Dart coverage. The new retired inode workflow steps test parses the YAML, verifies the current jobs, plants each of the eight removed steps in its owner job, observes refusal, removes it, and observes green. It does not retain the old positive Windows pin-step guards.

Verification.Command: bun test --timeout=0 scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts -t 'retired inode workflow steps'

T-003.Title: Repair measured test metrics after same-file test removal

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Hash the canonical sorted relative test paths and raw source bytes with SHA-256. artifactIsStale compares that digest and structural counts. A matching provisional artifact can satisfy the in-suite freshness predicate, but the runner remeasures it. Parse the just-run JUnit and compare case identities with multiplicity; write a measured artifact on digest or case-set change and leave the artifact byte-identical when both are unchanged. Refuse a source digest change during the run. Tests cover same-file deletion, changed filename, one-byte source edit, interrupted provisional recovery, no machine identifier, and stable unchanged bytes. The test titled real metrics runner invokes the actual scripts/test-metrics.ts CLI in a small disposable project and asserts the measured artifact, rather than calling only a helper. The final validate:ci performs the one metered repository suite and leaves no provisional cases.

Verification.Command: bun test --timeout=0 scripts/test-metrics.test.ts -t 'source digest|case multiset|provisional|real metrics runner'
